sections.Profile:
Big Casino , produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1961, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Card games, Casino
